label: Blind sample burn 003: MTBS Patton Meadow fire, OR, 2021-08-12

verdict.headline: No real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.09 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 12 Aug 2021 (90% interval −0.05 to +0.05). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 14 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.25). Counted by gap size instead, 6 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.11). The interval rules out a meaningful change beyond what the controls did.
reasons: a change of at least 0.05 in burn ratio (NBR) is ruled out by the interval

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar passes every test on its own: radar backscatter (VH) −0.3 dB, interval −0.4 to −0.1.
